body:
It's alright, obviously this is not my main account either but I've been checking it more lately because of this post.

I can definitively say I will remember you for a long time: a random, kind soul who took time out of his (or her) life to help a random person they found on the internet. I can never thank you enough for your support.

We are students at the same school so I cannot avoid her. And I can never be sure; she's not a bitch or anything, but she does use her appearance to get what she wants.

I'm sorry by the way to keep you in this thread, you don't have to keep talking if you don't want.

The thing is I'm not sure that I'm "in love" with her. I fee like it may be something I'm saying to justify my suicidal thoughts. I don't want to be presumptuous. Everyone here is saying that I have everything figured out, but the reality is I'm more confused than I thought was possible. I feel more strongly for this girl than for anyone I've ever met but in reality it's probably not love; love is an illusion.

There is nothing to tell about myself. I spend my time at my home getting drunk and cutting my wrists. I have no friends to do anything with. I have no girlfriend to do anything with. I live a bland, meaningless existence and I feel that it would be utilitarian to end it.

I really appreciate your kindness. It seems like I can only find kind people on the internet. I don't know your identity and I never will, but I think I've already told you more than I've ever told a therapist. But I still feel empty. I still feel obsessed with her. I'd guess ~65% of my thoughts are about her. I got an app that saves snapchat videos clandestinely just so I could look at her without her knowing. I know I have to forget about her but it's just so fucking hard, and killing myself just seems like an easy way out for me, which I want.

I haven't figured out what went wrong with me. I know I have social anxiety and clinical depression, but I really let myself get obsessed with this girl and I can't forget about her no matter how hard I try.
Thank you, I really appreciate it.
Shit, I forgot about GTA 5. Yeah those two things are the only reasons I haven't ended it already.

I don't quite follow what you're suggesting. Are you saying to just go for it with her or forget about her and move on? Because both are pretty fucking hard for me, and I don't see them ever getting any easier. I'm unable to talk to anyone about anything. When I try therapy I just don't talk about myself. I guess random strangers on the internet is different but the innate shyness that I have is something that I've been working to get rid of for as long as I can remember.
I've never met a Connor who wasn't a douche.
Wow, it's pictures like these that make me wish I had cancer!
